approved: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Land and Sea Future Fund (Consequential Amendments) Bill 2018
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill makes changes needed because of the new Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Land and Sea Future Fund Act 2018.
It would give the Future Fund Board new duties for the Land and Sea Future Fund and allow money to be moved between funds to share costs.
The bill would close the Land Account and move its balance into the new fund.
Give the Future Fund Board functions for the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Land and Sea Future Fund.
Allow transfers between the Land and Sea Future Fund and the Future Fund to share common expenses.
Close the Land Account and transfer its balance to the new fund.
The Future Fund Board and the Land Account are affected.

The Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Land and Sea Future Fund (Consequential Amendments) Bill 2018 was moved for second reading to amend several acts to establish the fund, and includes technical amendments renaming the Indigenous Land Corporation to the Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation.

Labor supported the bill to expand the Indigenous Land Corporation’s functions to include water-related rights, renaming it the Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation, following consultations where over 75% of sessions supported the reforms.

Labor supported the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Land and Sea Future Fund bill, which replaces the Indigenous Land Account and targets a return of CPI plus 2.6 per cent after fees, after the government agreed to amendments ensuring fund sustainability and restoring Indigenous Land Corporation oversight.

The bill closes the $2 billion Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Land Account and establishes a new Future Fund managed by the Future Fund Board of Guardians to invest in a broader range of products, aiming to ensure sustainable funding for the Indigenous Land Corporation. Annual payments to the Corporation will remain indexed at over $53 million, while additional payments will be reformed to support the fund's long-term sustainability.

The speaker moved four government amendments to the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Land and Sea Future Fund (Consequential Amendments) Bill 2018, replacing references to the "Indigenous Land Corporation Board" with "Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation Board" to align with separate renaming legislation. The amendments and bill were commended to the House to enable the effective operation of the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Land and Sea Future Fund.
